# MeedyaDL 1.9.0

A big jump forward: a new Library Scan page, a much more capable Queue (search, filters, bulk actions), automatic backups, download statistics, a GAMDL version manager, easier bug reporting, and a long list of reliability fixes — including two crash fixes from a same-day hotfix. This release folds together everything that shipped across the 1.6.0–1.9.0 line.

### What's new

- **Library Scan page.** A new sidebar page lets you point MeedyaDL at any folder of previously-downloaded music and see, at a glance, the artist, album, track count, audio quality, and last-download date for everything in it — plus flags for albums that are missing lyrics, artwork, or an audio-quality variant you'd expect, so you can re-queue just the gaps.
- **Queue search, filters, and bulk actions.** A search bar and status filters let you find specific downloads in a long queue, and you can now select multiple items and Cancel, Retry, or Remove them all at once instead of one at a time.
- **Automatic backups.** MeedyaDL now snapshots your settings, queue, and history automatically whenever it closes, keeping your 10 most recent snapshots. Settings → Tools → Backups lets you restore or delete any snapshot, or create one on demand.
- **Lifetime download statistics.** A new panel shows your all-time download count, success rate, a breakdown by audio format, and your most-downloaded artist and album.
- **GAMDL version manager.** Settings → Tools now shows whether your installed GAMDL version is supported, untested, or unsupported, and lets you install a specific version — including downgrading, which wasn't previously possible from within the app.
- **One-click diagnostic bundle for bug reports.** A new button composes a privacy-scrubbed report (app version, settings, recent activity log) and pre-fills a GitHub bug report for you — with a preview so you can see exactly what's being shared before anything is sent.
- **Output folder integrity scan.** A new diagnostic scan checks your download folder for damaged filenames left behind by very old MeedyaDL builds (empty titles, broken folder names, zero-byte cover art) and reports what it finds.
- **A heads-up when a template change needs a restart.** Editing a filename or folder template now clearly explains that the new template only applies to downloads queued after MeedyaDL restarts, with a one-click restart option.
- **Keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet** (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+?) lists every shortcut, plus new shortcuts for jumping to the Library, History, and Activity pages.
- **Animated hero art for albums**, alongside the existing artist and cover art videos, and **music videos now have their cover art built directly into the file** instead of leaving a separate image file next to it.
- **Companion downloads now show which track is downloading** in the progress bar instead of being stuck on the audio format name for the whole album.
- **A background safety net now watches every active download** and automatically frees up a stuck one after a period with no progress, so a single wedged download can no longer hold up your whole queue indefinitely.
- **The status bar now shows "downloading" and "processing" separately**, so you can tell at a glance whether an item is actively fetching audio or working through the finishing steps (tagging, lyrics, artwork).

### What's fixed

- **MeedyaDL no longer crashes on first launch on macOS.** A same-day hotfix for a startup bug introduced by the new background safety-net feature above.
- **Downloads no longer fail outright when using the `{platform}` template chip** in your filename or folder templates — another same-day hotfix. If this affected you before, the template chip now works as intended.
- **The queue no longer freezes indefinitely** when a slow network share or disconnected cloud drive hangs one of the finishing steps — MeedyaDL now gives up after 5 minutes and moves on instead of stalling the whole queue.
- **"Retry All Failed" no longer freezes the app** for minutes at a time on large queues — retrying dozens of failed downloads now happens near-instantly, with an immediate confirmation toast.
- **Downloads are no longer wrongly marked "Complete" when nothing actually downloaded** (for example, when none of your requested audio formats were available) — MeedyaDL now checks that files actually landed before declaring success.
- **The progress bar during multi-format companion downloads no longer looks stuck at 95%** for long stretches — it now visibly advances as each track completes.
- **Cross-region matching for cross-platform lookups now works correctly**, regardless of which country's Apple Music storefront your link came from.
- **Music videos land in the correct album folder far more often**, instead of always being filed into a generic "Music Videos" catch-all folder.
- **Confusing internal error codes in the Activity log** — for example, raw codec-list dumps when a format wasn't available — are now shown as clean, readable messages.
- **Personal-library link errors now show clear guidance** instead of a cryptic technical error.

### Performance

- **Settings are read from memory instead of from disk on every step of a download**, speeding up multi-item queues.
- **The Activity log only re-scans new entries when you search or filter it**, instead of rescanning everything — keeping long sessions responsive.
- **"Still working" heartbeat messages** now appear periodically during long steps (large-album audio analysis, multi-format companion downloads) so a quiet stretch never looks like a freeze.

### Notes

- **Wider GAMDL compatibility** was validated and admitted during this line, extending the range of GAMDL versions MeedyaDL officially supports.
- **Early groundwork for cross-platform link lookups** (matching a Spotify, YouTube, or other music link to its Apple Music equivalent) was added behind the scenes; the in-app interface for it is still to come.
- **Third-party licence compliance documentation** was added for every tool MeedyaDL bundles, along with an automated check that runs on every code change to keep it accurate.
